synopsis.text: Prince Namor, a.k.a. The Sub-Mariner, joins forces with Iron Man for the team-up of the century!

Firstly we see a flashback of Tony Stark remembering his past, where he recalls being injured in Vietnam, he also recalls falling into Wong-Chu’s clutches, and building his first armor with Ho Yinsen’s help. He also recalls his adventures with the Avengers, his heart being cured and his meeting with Nick Fury.

The scene shifts back to Namor, where we see him returning back to the ocean while Iron Man heads back to USA. Bethany Cabe watches him depart, still curious about him. As Iron Man returns home he muses over his origin and changes he has undergone since. Elsewhere, Justin Hammer meets his lackey Phillip Barnett and they prepare for a third test to control Iron Man’s armor.
Note: This issue contains the Hostess Superhero Ad, Spider-Man In "Hotshot On The Block"
